text:
Taylor: quick a11y sweep on the Model Activity header + runs list. Not huge but a few surprising behaviours for keyboard + screen readers. Dropping notes here.
Rina: thanks — can you TL;DR the main regressions?
Taylor: TL;DR: 1) header skip link focus jumps but is removed during animation so you can't use it twice; 2) streaming status live region reads every chunk (very chatty); 3) compact icon buttons lose visible focus in dark theme; 4) table rows only support tabbing not arrow-key navigation, so power users complain.
Priya: good list. Which are quick wins?
Taylor: quick wins: keep skip link node stable (don't recreate during show/hide); debounce live region updates to announce only state transitions; add a robust :focus-visible ring for icon buttons; and add lightweight JS ArrowLeft/Right handlers on rows.
Rina: repro for skip: open Console > Models > Activity, tab to top, activate "Skip to runs", focus jumps and we run a CSS entry animation that replaces the skip link node. If you tab back the link is gone. Fix: toggle an existing node's visibility via class and keep tabindex stable, add aria-controls="runs-list".
Priya: agree stable DOM is best. Also add aria-live="polite" role="status" aria-atomic="true" for summary announcements only.
Taylor: live region detail: currently we set liveRegion.textContent = streamingChunk on every chunk. NVDA/VO read everything. Proposal: maintain lastState and only set text when state changes (idle->streaming->complete) or every 25% progress. Debounce example: const announce = debounce(msg=> liveRegion.textContent = msg, 500); announce('Run 82: streaming started');
Sam: for streaming full text we should avoid aria-live for every token; visual stream is fine. If customers want verbose SR output offer a feature flag toggle. Also use aria-atomic so SR reads full message.
Rina: focus ring: which selector? icon-only toolbar and compact row actions. Current CSS removes outline for visual polish. Quick fix: add `.icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }` and ensure dark theme token contrasts.
Priya: include a token value that meets 4.5:1 for small elements.
Taylor: keyboard nav: table rows are currently passive containers. Add `tabindex=0` to rows and JS handlers: on Enter open actions, ArrowRight focus next cell button, ArrowLeft previous. If possible avoid wholesale switch to role=grid to limit regressions.
Sam: pattern note: when adding arrow handlers, call event.preventDefault() and ensure that interactive children remain tabbable. Add unit tests that simulate arrow keys.
a11y-bot: auto-audit: https://redwood-infra/audits/2250001111 — Contrast: WARN (compact pill hover), Focus-visible: FAIL (icon buttons), LiveRegion: FAIL (too frequent updates).
Priya: prioritization?
Rina: 1) stabilize skip link (low) 2) debounce live region + feature flag (med) 3) focus-visible CSS (low) 4) arrow-key handlers + tests (med).
Taylor: I'll open the small PR for skip link + focus styles today and include visual diffs. Rina will take the announcer debounce and feature flag next sprint. Sam will pair on arrow-key tests.
Priya: thanks — please add before/after screenshots and link the audit URL. Sam: can you run NVDA/VO pass after PR?
Sam: yes, will check and report any double-reads.
Taylor: thanks folks — adding notes to backlog card: https://redwood-infra/board/771 :white_check_mark:
